card.name: Words in religious and notice-style prose
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered words in Christian teaching text and in 'keep you informed' or 'information is provided' style sentences.

modes.label: Bible commentary
modes.description: Linking words and punctuation inside a quoted verse or a sentence about faith and salvation.
modes.example: Abraham was justified by works, he had something to boast about--<<but>> not before God.

modes.label: Informing phrases
modes.description: Verbs about keeping someone informed or providing information.
modes.example: we'll just keep you<< posted>> periodically

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese words for notices and instructions, but there is no clear output effect in English.
card.plain: It fires on mixed words in sermon-like text and in sentences about keeping people informed, with no tidy pattern.
